fieldNotes.title: Display title. Physical editions are represented in the separate format field, so trailing 4K labels are omitted from titles.
fieldNotes.studio: Studio/distributor as provided in the refined CSV.
fieldNotes.upc: UPC stored as a string to preserve exact digits.
fieldNotes.ean: EAN stored as a string to preserve leading zeros.
fieldNotes.year: Original release year from the refined CSV.
fieldNotes.director: Director values as supplied; slash-separated co-directors are treated as individual people for unique-director stats and director index.
fieldNotes.runtime: Runtime in minutes, summed for the homepage total-runtime statistic.
fieldNotes.genres: Genre from the refined CSV stored as an array.
fieldNotes.format: Physical format. The 15 Hitchcock entries requested by the user have been changed to 4K UHD.
fieldNotes.rating: TMDB audience vote average on a 0–10 scale. Null until fetched using enrich_tmdb.py; this is an audience rating, not a critic score or the user’s own rating.
fieldNotes.ratingSource: Provider used to source rating. Null until enrichment.
fieldNotes.ratingVotes: Number of TMDB votes behind the rating; null until enrichment.
fieldNotes.tmdbId: TMDB movie identifier for traceability; null until matched.
fieldNotes.posterUrl: TMDB w500 poster URL when a confident title/year match is found. Null until enrichment; CSS placeholder art remains in use.
